title: Catherine Morgan
clean_html:
Catherine Morgan

Preserved Primary Document • morgan-c.htm

Catherine Morgan was born 27 December, 1833. Her father was John Morgan , a member of the Kent Co., mixed blood community. In the 1850 Dover Hundred, Kent Co. census records we find Catherine (age 16, born in DE) but she is not living with her parents. Nearby we find John Morgan (age 34) living with his wife Mary (age 32) and no children so it is possible that these were Catherine's parents. Sometime before 1852 Catherine married Robert Dean . She and Robert had the following children : Mary Ann Dean (1852-1923) married Moses Coker John T. Dean (1856- ) Lucinda Dean (1857-1876) married William C. Johnson Jesse Dean (1858-1931) married Sarah SEENEY and Susan SAMMONS Robert B. Dean (1861-1940) married Almira Wilson William Frank Dean (1864- ) married Elizabeth MOSLEY Hester Dean (1868-1948) married Frederick Seeney Anna Elizabeth Dean (1870-1963) married Charles Henry MOSLEY Ullysses S. Dean After the death of her first husband, Robert Dean, on 30 September,1874, Catherine remarried, William CARNEY. Catherine died near Beresford in Kent Co. DE on 23 May, 1894. Her death certificate lists her age as 63 years, her race as "white" and the cause of death as "complications". She is buried next to her first husband at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold.
